value.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for Aho-Corasick literal scanning, portable grep rules, Unicode and entropy security checks and strict JSON and copy formatting
value.lets_workers: Scan multi-pattern literal catalogs in single-pass O(|text| + matches) time with AhoCorasickAutomaton, enforce ECMA-262 regex portability and sentence-level negation rules with PortableGrepRuleRunner, catch Trojan Source bidi overrides, Unicode Tag ASCII smuggling, SHA-256 hashed name leaks and mixed-class high-entropy secrets with UnicodeAndEntropySecurityScanner and enforce canonical duplicate-free JSON and clause-balanced captions with StrictJsonAndCopyFormatter.

flow.when: Run single-pass Aho-Corasick multi-pattern scans, validate ECMA-262 regex portability, scrub local home paths and check sentence-level outbound negation, secret prefixes, accusatory copy and placeholder stamps.

Verify NFC normalization, decode hidden Unicode Tag block payloads, flag Trojan Source bidi/zero-width/variation-selector characters, check SHA-256 name-hash blocklists and mask high-entropy tokens while exempting lowercase hex digests.
Independently verify strict duplicate-free canonical JSON, reject raw HTML entities and em-dashes, wrap clause-balanced two-line captions and confirm ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate conformance.

value.worked_example: Made-up multi-pattern, portable regex, Unicode Tag smuggling, SHA-256 name-hash, Shannon-entropy and strict JSON/caption bundle recomputed in test_rule_engine.py: matches whole-word Aho-Corasick literals, rejects lookbehind regex syntax, scrubs /Users/demo_worker/ paths, decodes hidden Tag payload 'hidden', exempts a 64-char SHA-256 digest while masking a 4-class high-entropy token, rejects duplicate JSON keys and wraps a clause-balanced two-line caption.
